blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Flower arrangements were seen at the Aquino family mausoleum at Manila Memorial Park-Sucat in Parañaque City on Friday, ahead of the Undas holidays. The tomb serves as the final resting place of prominent members of the Aquino family, particularly former President Benigno “Noynoy” Aquino III, former President Corazon “Cory” Aquino, and former Senator Benigno “Ninoy” Aquino Jr. READ: LIVE UPDATES: Undas 2026 | Oct. 30 Yellow candles were also lit in their honor, two days before All Saints’ Day.
